scope: Retained histogram/profile sample lookup and immutable compact source/target captions across shared ImGui and PNG output

implementation.sample_lookup: Editor.plot_sample_at(x, plot_id=0) and physical pointer hover query retained data in O(log N), with no source-provider reads, copies of sample arrays, processing jobs or history changes. x is finite data-space X; index is zero based. Live ID0 uses existing source/all-revision guard; positive snapshot IDs survive source closure. Calibration kind explicitly refuses this sample API.
implementation.histogram: Half-open bins; interior edge selects right bin; final upper edge included; outside bounds returns null/None. Exact uint64 count and double lower/upper edges retained, including counts above2^53. Rendering y uses double and is not an exact integer representation for all uint64 values.
implementation.profile: Nearest stored sample by X; ties and duplicate distances use first index. Out-of-range X clamps nearest endpoint. Capture validates finite nondecreasing distances. Existing float-rounded samples/sampling/calibration semantics preserved.
implementation.result_schema: kind,index,x,y,source_id,payload_id,x_label,y_label,context_caption; histogram adds lower,upper,upper_inclusive,count. Boolean/nonfinite X, unknown fields, Boolean/fractional/negative IDs refuse.
implementation.context: Prepared before publication and admitted with immutable payload memory. Captures one-based T/C/Z, selection kind, pooled target ranges/steps or explicit-order count/first position, and whole-plane/active-area/positioned-ROI-union policy. Preserved after navigation, retitle and source/panel closure. Compact summary does not reconstruct complete explicit target ordering or ROI geometry.
implementation.consumers: Legacy histogram, line/polyline profile, scientific histogram and all three calibration plot publication routes. Calibration captions describe dataset calibration and captured view, not calibration sampling from that one plane. Scientific result context copied with retained result/rebind drafts.
implementation.display: Live plot caption and third standalone PNG header line. Existing fixed white background, built-in13px font/fallback, bounded/clipped caption policy retained. Shared payload retains no source document/provider; no full target JSON serialized each frame.
implementation.api_boundary: Private desktop interface plus Python convenience API. No public native core SDK API changes or installed core SDK refresh.
